chapters.name: Unit 1 Text A New Words

words.tr:
adj. 警觉的；警惕的；
n. 警报；
v. （使）警惕；（使）戒备；
words.ex: The alert guard noticed the strange movement.
words.ex_cn: 这位警觉的警卫注意到了奇怪的动静。
words.en: If you are alert, you are paying full attention to things around you and are able to deal with anything that might happen.

words.ex: The alpine flowers bloom in the high mountains.
words.ex_cn: 高山上的花朵在高山上绽放。
words.en: Relating to high mountains, especially the Alps.

words.ex: The violent news appalls her.
words.ex_cn: 这起暴力新闻令她震惊。
words.en: to fill with horror or dismay; shock deeply

words.tr:
prep. 在…顶上
adv. 在上面；到上面
words.ex: The cat sat atop the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在屋顶上。
words.en: On top of something.

words.tr: n. 边远地区；穷乡僻壤
words.ex: He spent his childhood in the backcountry, far from the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在穷乡僻壤度过了童年，远离城市。
words.en: A backcountry is a remote and undeveloped area, often far from cities and towns, where the natural environment is largely untouched.

words.tr: adj. 离奇的；奇特的；奇怪的；
words.ex: The clown wore a bizarre hat with three eyes.
words.ex_cn: 小丑戴着一顶有三只眼睛的离奇帽子。
words.en: Something that is bizarre is very odd and strange.

words.tr:
adj. 空白的；
n. 空白处；
words.ex: The paper had a blank space at the top.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸的顶部有一个空白区域。
words.en: If something is blank, it has nothing on it.

words.ex: He uses broadband to watch videos online.
words.ex_cn: 他使用宽带在线观看视频。
words.en: A type of high-speed Internet access that is always on and faster than the traditional dial-up access.

words.ex: The cacophony of car horns made it hard to think.
words.ex_cn: 汽车喇叭的刺耳噪音让人难以思考。
words.en: A cacophony is a mixture of loud and usually unpleasant sounds.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.tr: n. 星座；一群杰出人物；一系列（相关的想法、事物）
words.ex: He saw the Orion constellation in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 他在夜空中看到了猎户座。
words.en: A constellation is a group of stars which form a pattern and have a name.

words.tr: n. 顾问；咨询师；法律顾问；
words.ex: He asked his counselor for advice about his future.
words.ex_cn: 他向他的顾问咨询了关于未来的问题。
words.en: A counselor is a person whose job is to give advice to people who need it, especially advice on their personal problems.

words.tr: phrase. 覆盖范围的文字说明；用于描述某项服务或产品覆盖区域的标注文字
words.ex: The map includes a coverage lettering that explains the service areas.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图包含了一段文字说明，解释了服务范围。
words.en: Text or lettering used to describe or provide information about an insurance policy's coverage.

words.ex: He will delete the old file.
words.ex_cn: 他会删除那个旧文件。
words.en: To delete something means to remove it or erase it.

words.tr: v. 使遭危险或伤害；危害；危及
words.ex: Pollution can endanger animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染会危及动物。
words.en: To put someone or something at risk or in danger.

words.ex: The police enforce the law.
words.ex_cn: 警察强制执行法律。
words.en: If people in authority enforce a law or a rule, they make sure that it is obeyed, usually by punishing people who do not obey it.

words.tr: n. 恶作剧；（危险而愚蠢的）冒险行为
words.ex: His funny escapade made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他那滑稽的淘气行为让大家都笑了。
words.en: An escapade is an exciting and somewhat dangerous adventure, especially one that is not very sensible or is against the rules.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: He was formerly a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他以前是一名老师。
words.en: Previously; in the past.

words.ex: The sky looks heavenly at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时天空看起来像天上的。
words.en: If you describe something as heavenly, you mean that it is extremely pleasant or enjoyable.

words.tr:
n. 远足；
v. 远足；
words.ex: We went on a long hike in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们去山里进行了一次长途远足。
words.en: A hike is a long walk in the country, especially one that you go on for pleasure. It can also refer to an increase in the cost or amount of something.

words.ex: His inability to swim saved him from drowning.
words.ex_cn: 他不会游泳，这救了他一命。
words.en: If you refer to someone's inability to do something, you are emphasizing that they cannot do it.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的; n. 无关紧要的东西
words.ex: The color is inessential to the function.
words.ex_cn: 颜色对于功能来说是不必要的。
words.en: If you describe something as inessential, you mean that it is not absolutely necessary.

words.ex: He gave an intentional wrong answer to confuse the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他故意答错答案来迷惑老师。
words.en: Something that is intentional is done on purpose, not by chance.

words.tr: n. 胡说八道；【俚】bullshit 胡说
words.ex: Stop the jibber-jabber and get to the point.
words.ex_cn: 别胡说八道了，直奔主题吧。
words.en: Rapid and incoherent talk; nonsense.

words.ex: The soldiers stayed at the remote outpost.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们驻守在偏远的前哨站。
words.en: An outpost is a small military camp or position at some distance from the main army, used especially as a guard against surprise attack.

words.ex: He made a persistent effort to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他持续努力学习英语。
words.en: Continuing firmly or obstinately in a course of action in spite of difficulty or opposition.

words.tr: n. 沙漠中的盆地，海边休养地
words.ex: The playa is a unique landscape formed by the periodic flooding of desert basins.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠盆地中的干湖床是由周期性洪水形成的独特景观。
words.en: A playa is a flat, dry lake bed found in deserts, or a beach or shore, especially in Spanish-speaking countries.

words.tr: v. 居住于；生活于；移民于
words.ex: Many people populate this small town.
words.ex_cn: 许多人居住在这个小镇上。
words.en: To populate an area means to live in it or to fill it with people or things.

words.tr: adj. 突出的；杰出的；显著的；
words.ex: He is a prominent scientist in the field of medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他是医学领域的一位突出的科学家。
words.en: Someone or something that is prominent is important and well-known, or is positioned in a way that makes them easily seen or noticed.

words.ex: He is the protagonist in the story.
words.ex_cn: 他是故事中的主角。
words.en: The main character in a story, play, film, etc., especially the one who is good or who the audience is expected to support.

words.ex: He believes in reductionism, saying everything can be explained by simple parts.
words.ex_cn: 他相信还原论，认为一切都可以用简单的部分来解释。
words.en: Reductionism is the practice of analyzing and describing a complex phenomenon in terms of phenomena that are held to represent a simpler or more fundamental level, especially when this is said to provide a sufficient explanation.

words.ex: He fixed the router to get internet back.
words.ex_cn: 他修好了路由器，恢复了网络。
words.en: A router is a device that forwards data packets between computer networks.

words.tr: v. 厚厚地覆盖；使…窒息；闷死
words.ex: He tried to smother the fire with a blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用毯子把火闷灭。
words.en: To smother someone or something means to kill them by covering their face so that they cannot breathe, or to put out a fire by covering it.

words.tr: adj. 自鸣得意的；沾沾自喜的
words.ex: He smiled in a smug way after winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在赢得比赛后得意地笑了。
words.en: If you say that someone is smug, you are criticizing the fact they seem very pleased with how good, clever, or lucky they are.

words.tr:
n. 快照；
v. 突然断裂；猛然咬；
adj. 突然的；匆忙的；
words.ex: He took a snap of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的快照。
words.en: If something snaps or if you snap it, it breaks suddenly, usually with a sharp cracking noise. | A snap is a photograph. | If someone snaps, or if something snaps inside them, they suddenly stop being calm and become very angry.

words.ex: The houses are sparsely spread across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 房子稀疏地分布在沙漠中。
words.en: In a sparse manner; not densely or thickly.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.tr:
v. 眯着眼看；斜视
n. 斜视；一瞥
words.ex: He squints to see the small letters.
words.ex_cn: 他眯着眼睛看那些小字。
words.en: To squint means to look at something with your eyes partly closed in order to see better, or because of bright light. It can also refer to a condition where the eyes do not look in the same direction.

words.ex: He set the timer for ten minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他把计时器设为十分钟。
words.en: A timer is a device that measures time intervals and signals the end of a specified period.

words.tr:
n. 踪迹；轨道；小路；跑道；
v. 追踪；跟踪；
words.ex: The dog followed the track of the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 狗跟着兔子的踪迹。
words.en: A track is a path or route along which something moves or travels. It can also refer to marks left by something that has passed, or the act of following such marks to find someone or something.

words.ex: We started our hike at the trailhead.
words.ex_cn: 我们从步道的起点开始徒步。
words.en: The point where a trail begins.

words.ex: He unfolded the map on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把地图在桌子上展开。
words.en: To open or spread out something that is folded; to develop or be revealed.

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.ex: The hikers got lost in the wilderness.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者在荒野中迷路了。
words.en: A wilderness is a wild and uncultivated region, as of forest or desert, uninhabited or inhabited only by wild animals.

chapters.name: Unit 1 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: The room is free of dust.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有灰尘。
words.en: If something is free of something else, it does not have that thing in it or on it.

words.tr: phrase. 不受……影响的；摆脱了……的；无……的
words.ex: He wants to be free of worries.
words.ex_cn: 他想摆脱烦恼。
words.en: To be without something that is unwanted or unpleasant.

words.ex: I will help you, but I draw the line at lying.
words.ex_cn: 我会帮你，但我绝不撒谎。
words.en: To set a limit at what one is willing to do or accept.

words.tr: 短语动词. 对…划清界限；拒绝接受某事
words.ex: I can tolerate a lot, but I draw the line at lying.
words.ex_cn: 我可以容忍很多事情，但我不能容忍撒谎。
words.en: To set a limit at a particular activity, indicating that one will not go beyond it, often because one considers it wrong or unacceptable.

words.tr: 短语动词. 远离一切烦恼；彻底放松；摆脱日常琐事
words.ex: He went to the mountains to get away from it all.
words.ex_cn: 他去山里远离一切烦恼。
words.en: To escape from one's usual environment or daily routine, often for relaxation or to avoid stress.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有道理；说得对
words.ex: You have a point about saving money.
words.ex_cn: 你关于存钱的说法有道理。
words.en: If someone has a point, what they say is reasonable or correct, especially when they are disagreeing with you.

words.tr: phrase. 与...一起住；接受并忍受
words.ex: He has to live with the noise from the street.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不忍受来自街道的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or accept something unpleasant; to cohabit with someone.

words.tr: phrase. /adj. 脱离电网的；不依赖公共供电的；远离尘嚣的；隐居的
words.ex: They decided to live off the grid, relying on solar panels and a well for water.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定脱离电网生活，依靠太阳能电池板和水井供水。
words.en: Not connected to the main or national electrical grid; not connected to or served by publicly or commercially managed utilities (such as electricity, water supply, or sewage disposal).

words.ex: I saved all my money save for one dollar.
words.ex_cn: 我把所有的钱都存起来了，除了一美元。
words.en: If you say that something is true save for a particular thing, you mean that it is true except for that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 端上（食物或饮料）；提供（尤指娱乐或信息）
words.ex: He serves up coffee every morning at the small café.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在小咖啡馆供应咖啡。
words.en: To provide or offer something, especially food or drink, to someone.

words.tr: phrase. 蔑视；嗤之以鼻；对…不屑一顾
words.ex: He can sniff at the flower.
words.ex_cn: 他可以闻一闻那朵花。
words.en: To express disdain or scorn for something.

chapters.name: Unit 1 Text B New Words

words.ex: His rude behavior alienated his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的行为使朋友们疏远了他。
words.en: To cause someone to feel isolated or estranged; to transfer the ownership of property to another.

words.ex: The long silence caused alienation between them.
words.ex_cn: 长久的沉默导致了他们之间的离间。
words.en: Alienation refers to the state or experience of being isolated from a group or an activity to which one should belong or in which one should be involved.

words.ex: He wiped the sweat from his brow.
words.ex_cn: 他擦去了额头上的汗水。
words.en: The brow refers to the eyebrow or the forehead, and can also denote the top edge of a steep place such as a cliff.

words.ex: The bunny hops in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 兔子在花园里跳跃。
words.en: A bunny is a child's word for a rabbit.

words.tr:
n. 插图说明；标题；字幕
v. 加上说明；加上标题；加上字幕
words.ex: The photo has a caption that says 'Happy birthday'.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片有一个标题，写着‘生日快乐’。
words.en: A caption is a short piece of text under a picture in a book, magazine, or newspaper that describes the picture or explains what is happening in it.

words.tr: n. 小型爵士乐队；结合物
words.ex: The combo played jazz at the small club last night.
words.ex_cn: 这个小型爵士乐队昨晚在小俱乐部演奏了爵士乐。
words.en: A combo is a small group of musicians who play jazz, dance, or popular music together.

words.tr:
v. 称赞；恭维
n. 称赞；恭维
words.ex: He gave her a compliment on her dress.
words.ex_cn: 他夸了她的裙子。
words.en: A compliment is a polite expression of praise or admiration.

words.ex: He was conscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后他醒了过来。
words.en: If you are conscious of something, you notice it or are aware of it.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: The teacher gave a demonstration of how to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师演示了如何解这道数学题。
words.en: A demonstration is a public meeting or march in which people show their opposition to something or their support for something.

words.ex: He faced a dilemma: stay home or go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困境：是待在家里还是去上班。
words.en: A situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives, especially equally undesirable ones.

words.tr: adj. 闲散的; 脱离的; 自由的; 未约束的 v. 分开( disengage的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He looked disengaged during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间显得闲散。
words.en: If someone is disengaged from something, they are not involved in it or do not feel part of it.

words.tr: adj. 有启迪作用的； v. “enlighten”的现在分词；
words.ex: The talk was enlightening and helped me understand life better.
words.ex_cn: 这场演讲很有启发性，帮助我更好地理解了人生。
words.en: Providing insight, understanding, or knowledge.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.ex: He had a flashback to his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他突然想起了自己的童年。
words.en: A flashback is a scene in a movie, novel, etc., set in a time earlier than the main story.

words.tr:
n. 犁沟；车辙；皱纹
v. 犁耕；使皱眉头
words.ex: The farmer plowed a deep furrow in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农夫在田里犁出了一条深深的犁沟。
words.en: A furrow is a long narrow trench made in the ground by a plow, especially for planting seeds or for irrigation. It can also refer to a deep wrinkle on a person's face.

words.ex: She laughed hysterically at the funny joke.
words.ex_cn: 她听到这个搞笑的笑话时 hysterically 大笑。
words.en: In a wildly emotional or uncontrolled manner.

words.ex: He values individualism in his work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中重视个人主义。
words.en: Individualism is the belief that the rights and freedom of the individual are the most important rights in a society.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.tr: n. 相互作用；相互影响；互动交流；
words.ex: The interaction between the two chemicals causes a reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质之间的相互作用引起反应。
words.en: An interaction is a situation where two or more people or things communicate with or react to each other.

words.tr: adj. 无价的；非常宝贵的；
words.ex: Her advice was invaluable to me.
words.ex_cn: 她的建议对我而言是无价的。
words.en: If you describe something as invaluable, you mean that it is extremely useful.

words.ex: The manifestation of his anger was a loud shout.
words.ex_cn: 他愤怒的显示是一声大喊。
words.en: A manifestation is an event, action, or object that clearly shows or embodies something, especially a theory or an abstract idea.

words.tr: adj. 唯物论的；物质至上主义的
words.ex: He is materialistic and only cares about money.
words.ex_cn: 他是个唯物论者，只关心钱。
words.en: If you describe a person or society as materialistic, you are critical of them because they attach too much importance to money and material possessions.

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.tr: adv. 谦虚地；谨慎地；适度地
words.ex: She modestly accepted the award.
words.ex_cn: 她谦虚地接受了奖项。
words.en: In a way that is not excessive or extreme; with modesty.

words.ex: He has three hobbies, namely reading, swimming, and painting.
words.ex_cn: 他有三个爱好，即阅读、游泳和绘画。
words.en: You use namely to introduce detailed information about the subject you are discussing, or a particular aspect of it.

words.ex: He shows narcissism by always talking about himself.
words.ex_cn: 他总是谈论自己，表现出自恋。
words.en: Narcissism is the habit of always thinking about yourself and your appearance and abilities, and believing that you are better than other people.

words.tr: n. 痴迷；困扰；着魔；强迫观念；
words.ex: His obsession with video games made him ignore his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏的痴迷让他忽略了学业。
words.en: An obsession is an idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person's mind.

words.tr: n. 得罪人的人；犯罪者；违法者；
words.ex: He was punished because he was an offender who hurt his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为是一个得罪朋友的人而受到惩罚。
words.en: An offender is a person who commits a crime or does something wrong.

words.ex: He has prejudice against people from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他对来自其他国家的人有偏见。
words.en: Prejudice is an unreasonable dislike of a particular group of people or things, or a preference for one group of people or things over another.

words.tr: v. 公开承认；宣布；声称
words.ex: He professes to love music.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己热爱音乐。
words.en: If you profess to do or have something, you claim that you do it or have it.

words.tr: n. 受公众注意的程度；简介；轮廓；
words.ex: The celebrity's profile rose after the TV interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人经过电视采访后，受公众注意的程度提高了。
words.en: A profile is a side view of something, especially a person's face, or a brief description of someone or something.

words.ex: He reaffirmed his commitment to the team.
words.ex_cn: 他重申了对团队的承诺。
words.en: If you reaffirm something, you state it again clearly and firmly.

words.tr: v. 使浪漫化；使传奇化；使夸张化
words.ex: She tends to romanticize the past.
words.ex_cn: 她倾向于将过去浪漫化。
words.en: To romanticize something means to make it seem more exciting or attractive than it really is.

words.tr: n. 聚精会神，热衷，专心致致
words.ex: Her self-absorption made it difficult for her to notice the needs of others.
words.ex_cn: 她的聚精会神使她难以注意到他人的需求。
words.en: The state of being preoccupied with one's own thoughts, feelings, and experiences to the exclusion of others.

words.ex: He finds self-actualization through painting every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天绘画实现自我实现。
words.en: The realization or fulfillment of one's talents and potentialities, especially considered as a drive or need present in everyone.

words.ex: He took a selfie with his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他和狗拍了一张自拍。
words.en: A photograph that one has taken of oneself, typically one taken with a smartphone or webcam and shared via social media.

words.ex: Her self-promotion skills were evident in every presentation she gave.
words.ex_cn: 她在每次演讲中展现出的自我推销技巧显而易见。
words.en: The act of promoting or publicizing oneself or one's activities, especially in a way perceived as excessive or unwarranted.

words.ex: He learned about sexual health in school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习了性健康。
words.en: Relating to the instincts, physiological processes, and activities connected with physical attraction or intimate physical contact between individuals.

words.tr: adj. 无耻的；脸皮厚的；不知羞耻的
words.ex: He gave a shameless excuse for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他为迟到提供了一个无耻的借口。
words.en: If you describe someone as shameless, you mean that they should be ashamed of their behavior, which is unacceptable to other people.

words.tr: adj. <非正式>方向（或角度）倾斜的
words.ex: The handwriting was slanty and hard to read.
words.ex_cn: 笔迹倾斜，难以阅读。
words.en: Something that is slanty is not straight but leans to one side.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The victim cried for help.
words.ex_cn: 受害者呼救。
words.en: A victim is someone who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event or action.

words.tr: n. 志愿精神；志愿服务
words.ex: The event was organized to promote volunteerism in the community.
words.ex_cn: 这次活动旨在促进社区的志愿服务精神。
words.en: Volunteerism refers to the use or involvement of volunteer labor, especially in community services.

words.ex: It is worthwhile to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是值得的。
words.en: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful enough to make the effort or money spent on it seem reasonable.

words.tr:
n. 渴望；向往
adj. 渴望的；向往的
v. 渴望；渴求；“yearn”的现在分词
words.ex: He has a yearning for home.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望回家。
words.en: A yearning is a strong feeling of wanting something, especially something that you know you may not be able to have.

chapters.name: Unit 1 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: The car moves at the speed of light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以光速行驶。
words.en: moving or occurring at a specified rate of motion or progress

words.tr: phrase. 关心的；有关的；涉及……的
words.ex: She is concerned with her son's health.
words.ex_cn: 她关心她儿子的健康。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are interested in it or involved in it.

words.ex_cn: 他关心他的成绩。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are giving it your attention because you think it is important or because you are worried about it.

words.tr: phrase. 无法用言语表达的；难以言喻的
words.ex: Her joy was beyond words.
words.ex_cn: 她的喜悦无法用言语表达。
words.en: If something is beyond words, it is impossible to describe it in words.

words.tr: phrase. 以...为中心；集中于...；围绕
words.ex: The discussion will center around one main idea.
words.ex_cn: 讨论将围绕一个主要观点展开。
words.en: To have something as the main subject of attention or interest.

words.tr: phrase. 过分关注；固着于；对……着迷
words.ex: She tends to fixate on small details and misses the bigger picture.
words.ex_cn: 她往往专注于小细节而忽略了更大的画面。
words.en: To fixate on something means to focus all your attention on it, often to an excessive degree.

words.tr: 短语. 为了保险起见；额外增加以确保充分或彻底
words.ex: She added some spices to the dish for good measure.
words.ex_cn: 她在菜里额外加了一些香料。
words.en: as an extra amount or as something additional

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He succeeded in part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他部分成功是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To some extent; not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 与……合作；与……合伙；与……建立伙伴关系
words.ex: The company is working in partnership with local schools to improve education.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在与当地学校合作以改善教育。
words.en: In collaboration or cooperation with someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 以同样的方式；同样地
words.ex: She dressed in the same manner as her sister.
words.ex_cn: 她以和她姐姐同样的方式穿着。
words.en: In the same way; similarly.

words.tr: phrase. 彻底了结地；一劳永逸地
words.ex: He solved the problem once and for all.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底解决了这个问题。
words.en: If something is done once and for all, it is done completely and finally.

words.ex: He prides himself on being honest.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实为傲。
words.en: If you pride yourself on a quality or skill that you have, you are very proud of it because you think it makes you special or successful.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.ex: The medicine has a side effect of dizziness.
words.ex_cn: 这种药有头晕的副作用。
words.en: An effect of a drug or chemical that is in addition to its intended effect, especially an effect that is harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr: phrase. 引人注目；突出；出色
words.ex: Her red hat makes her stand out in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她的红帽子让她在人群中很显眼。
words.en: To be very noticeable or obvious, especially in comparison to others.

words.ex: The children take turns to play with the toy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们轮流玩这个玩具。
words.en: If people take turns doing something, they do it one after the other to ensure that each person has an equal opportunity to do it.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Text A New Words

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.ex: The birds made a soft chatter in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨鸟儿发出轻柔的啁啾声。
words.en: If you chatter, you talk quickly and continuously, usually about things which are not important.

words.tr:
n. 喧嚷；大声的要求
v. 喧嚷；大声地要求
words.ex: The crowd made a loud clamor for justice.
words.ex_cn: 人群为正义发出大声喧哗。
words.en: If people are clamoring for something, they are demanding it in a noisy or angry way.

words.ex: I watched a clip of the movie on YouTube.
words.ex_cn: 我在YouTube上看了这部电影的一个片段。
words.en: A clip is a small device, usually made of metal or plastic, that is specially shaped for holding things together. As a verb, to clip means to cut something, especially to make it shorter or neater.

words.tr: adj. 有同情心的；表示怜悯的；
words.ex: She is a compassionate teacher who helps struggling students.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位有同情心的老师，帮助学习困难的学生。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as compassionate, you mean that they feel or show pity, sympathy, and understanding for people who are suffering.

words.ex: The old man built a strange contraption to water his plants.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人造了一个奇妙的装置来给他的植物浇水。
words.en: A contraption is a device or machine that is unusual or complicated, often made in an unusual or complicated way.

words.tr:
n. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
v. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
words.ex: The car crash happened at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碰撞发生在十字路口。
words.en: If a vehicle crashes or if the driver crashes it, it hits something and is damaged or destroyed.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲；曲线；
v. （使）弯成弧形；
words.ex: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
words.ex_cn: 前面的路有一个急转弯。
words.en: A curve is a smooth, gradually bending line, for example part of the edge of a circle.

words.ex: This program supports developmental milestones in children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目支持儿童的发展阶段。
words.en: Developmental is an adjective that describes something related to the growth or development of someone or something.

words.ex: He stared at the money with disbelief.
words.ex_cn: 他难以置信地盯着那些钱。
words.en: Disbelief is the feeling of not being able to believe that something is true or real.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.tr:
n. 尽力；尝试；
v. 尽力；奋力；
words.ex: His endeavor to finish the project took all his energy.
words.ex_cn: 他为完成这个项目付出了全部努力。
words.en: An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.

words.tr:
n. 决策人；行政官；管理人员；
adj. 行政的；决策的；
words.ex: The executive decided to launch the new product.
words.ex_cn: 这位决策人决定推出新产品。
words.en: An executive is a person who has a senior management position in a business or other organization.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.ex: He will not forsake his family.
words.ex_cn: 他不会抛弃他的家人。
words.en: If you forsake someone, you leave them when you should have stayed, or you stop helping them or looking after them.

words.ex: The horseshoe is nailed to a horse's hoof.
words.ex_cn: 马蹄形铁掌被钉在马的蹄子上。
words.en: A horseshoe is a piece of metal shaped like a U, which is fixed with nails to the bottom of a horse's foot in order to protect it.

words.tr: n. 含意；可能的影响（或后果）；暗示；
words.ex: The implication of his words was that he was sorry.
words.ex_cn: 他话中的含意是他很抱歉。
words.en: An implication is a possible future effect or result of an action or decision, often one that is not immediately obvious.

words.ex: He was imprisoned for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃而被监禁。
words.en: To put someone in prison or keep them as a prisoner.

words.ex: He is an influential teacher in our school.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们学校一位有影响力的老师。
words.en: Having great influence on someone or something.

words.ex: She wore a delicate lavaliere around her neck.
words.ex_cn: 她脖子上戴着一条精致的垂饰。
words.en: A lavaliere is a piece of jewelry that hangs from a necklace, typically made of a gemstone or metal.

words.ex: The locomotive pulled the train down the track.
words.ex_cn: 机车拉着火车沿着轨道行驶。
words.en: A locomotive is a powered rail vehicle used for pulling trains.

words.tr:
n. 低语声；嘟哝
v. 低语；咕哝；私下抱怨
words.ex: I heard a murmur from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来低语声。
words.en: A murmur is a low, indistinct, continuous sound, as of a stream or of voices.

words.ex: He has a clear notion of right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他对对错有清晰的概念。
words.en: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

words.ex: The oncoming storm made everyone hurry home.
words.ex_cn: 即将到来的风暴让所有人都赶紧回家。
words.en: An oncoming thing is moving towards you and is likely to reach you or affect you soon.

words.ex: He ate a fresh oyster for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了一个新鲜的牡蛎。
words.en: An oyster is a large flat shellfish. Some oysters can be eaten and others produce valuable objects called pearls.

words.ex: The plumber fixed the leaky pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了漏水的管道。
words.en: A plumber is a person whose job is to connect and repair things such as water and drainage pipes, baths, and toilets.

words.ex: He stood on the podium to receive the gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 他站在领奖台上领取金牌。
words.en: A podium is a small platform on which someone stands to give a speech or conduct an orchestra, or on which a medal winner stands during a prize-giving ceremony.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.tr:
v. （使）成波浪状；（使）起涟漪；作潺潺声 
n. 微波；涟漪；潺潺声
words.ex: The wind ripples the surface of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 风使湖面泛起波浪。
words.en: If something ripples, it moves in small waves or if you ripple it, you make it move in small waves.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.tr: adj. 专门的；专业的； v. “specialize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a specialized job in computer repair.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作是专门修理电脑的。
words.en: Requiring or involving detailed and specific knowledge or training.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.ex: The rocket's thrust lifted it into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 火箭的推力将它送上了天空。
words.en: To thrust something somewhere means to push it there quickly and forcefully. A thrust is also a powerful push or movement.

words.ex: The eagle unfurled its wings and soared into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 鹰展开翅膀，翱翔于天空。
words.en: If you unfurl something rolled or folded such as an umbrella, sail, or flag, you open it, so that it is spread out. You can also say that it unfurls.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: A host of students came to the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生来听讲座了。
words.en: A large number of something.

words.tr: 短语动词. 违背潮流；逆势而为；不随大流
words.ex: Despite the economic downturn, their company managed to buck the trend and increase its profits.
words.ex_cn: 尽管经济下滑，他们的公司还是逆势而行，增加了利润。
words.en: To act or move in a way that is contrary to a prevailing trend or pattern.

words.ex: A square is by definition a shape with four equal sides.
words.ex_cn: 正方形定义上就是有四条相等边的形状。
words.en: If you say that something is true by definition, you mean that it is true because of the nature of the thing being discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为中心；重点在于…
words.ex: The lesson centers on basic math skills.
words.ex_cn: 这节课的重点是基本数学技能。
words.en: To have something as the main subject of attention or interest.

words.tr: phrase. v. 勾选；核对并标记完成
words.ex: He checks off each task when he finishes it.
words.ex_cn: 他每完成一项任务就打个勾。
words.en: To mark something on a list as completed or verified.

words.tr: phrase. v. 让开；避开；别挡路
words.ex: Please get out of the way so I can pass.
words.ex_cn: 请让开，让我过去。
words.en: To move aside or stop obstructing someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.tr: phrase. 开始生效；起作用；踢开；捐献（钱或资源）
words.ex: The medicine will kick in after an hour.
words.ex_cn: 药物一小时后会起作用。
words.en: If something kicks in, it begins to take effect or to happen.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Text B New Words

words.ex: This phone is affordable for students.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机对学生来说价格合理。
words.en: If something is affordable, most people have enough money to buy it.

words.ex: There are many shops on this avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这条大街上有许多商店。
words.en: An avenue is a wide street or main thoroughfare, often lined with trees or other landscaping.

words.tr: n. 古典学者，古典主义者
words.ex: He was a classicist who specialized in ancient Greek literature.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位专门研究古希腊文学的古典学者。
words.en: A classicist is someone who studies or is devoted to the classics, especially the literature, art, or culture of ancient Greece and Rome.

words.ex: The public condemned the corrupt politician.
words.ex_cn: 公众谴责了这位腐败的政客。
words.en: If you condemn something, you say that it is very bad and unacceptable.

words.ex: He is a conscientious student who always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个尽责的学生，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is conscientious is very careful to do their work properly.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.ex: The defiant child refused to clean his room.
words.ex_cn: 这个不顺从的孩子拒绝打扫房间。
words.en: If you say that someone is defiant, you mean they show aggression or independence by refusing to obey someone.

words.tr: phrase. 分期付款的首次付款；预付定金
words.ex: He made a down payment on a new car.
words.ex_cn: 他为一辆新车付了首付款。
words.en: A down payment is a sum of money that you pay when you are buying something expensive such as a car or a house and cannot pay the full amount immediately. You pay the down payment first and then pay the rest later.

words.tr:
adv. 向下地；
adj. 向下的；
words.ex: The leaves fell downward slowly.
words.ex_cn: 树叶慢慢向下飘落。
words.en: Moving or leading towards a lower place or level

words.ex: He is eminently qualified for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他不寻常地适合这份工作。
words.en: To an eminent degree; very.

words.tr: n.可雇性; 可用性; 适于雇用; 受雇就业能力
words.ex: He wants to improve his employability by learning new skills.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过学习新技能来提高就业能力。
words.en: Employability refers to the ability of an individual to gain and maintain employment.

words.ex: She is highly employable due to her extensive experience.
words.ex_cn: 由于她丰富的经验，她非常有资格任职。
words.en: If someone is employable, they are suitable for being employed, usually because they have the necessary skills or qualities.

words.tr: v. 强烈吸引住；使着迷；
words.ex: The magic show fascinated the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演深深吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: Wearing blue jeans is fashionable now.
words.ex_cn: 现在穿牛仔裤很时髦。
words.en: Something that is fashionable is popular or approved of at a particular time.

words.ex: He incurred a fine for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 他因超速而招致了一笔罚款。
words.en: If you incur something unpleasant, it happens to you because of something you have done.

words.ex: It's an irony that the fire station burned down.
words.ex_cn: 消防站着火了，这真是讽刺。
words.en: Irony is a subtle form of humor which involves saying things that you do not mean.

words.tr: adj. 不负责任的；无责任感的；
words.ex: He is irresponsible because he never pays his bills.
words.ex_cn: 他从不付账单，所以是不负责任的。
words.en: If you describe someone as irresponsible, you are criticizing them because they do things without properly considering their possible consequences.

words.tr: adj. 可管理的；可应付的；可处理的；
words.ex: The project is manageable if we work together.
words.ex_cn: 如果我们一起合作，这个项目是可以管理的。
words.en: If you describe something as manageable, you mean that it is easy to control or deal with.

words.tr: adj. 非职业的；非专业的
words.ex: The course is designed for non-vocational students.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程是为非职业学生设计的。
words.en: Not relating to or concerned with a particular occupation or profession.

words.tr: adj. 奇怪的；奇数的；余的；
words.ex: He wore an odd hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as odd, you mean that they are strange or unusual.

words.ex: The unfair verdict caused public outrage.
words.ex_cn: 不公正的判决引发了公众的愤怒。
words.en: An outrage is an extremely strong reaction of anger, shock, or indignation.

words.ex: He lives in penury after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后生活贫困。
words.en: Penury is the state of being extremely poor.

words.tr: n. 管道工程； v. “plumb”的现在分词；
words.ex: He works as a plumber and fixes plumbing in houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名水管工，负责修理房屋的管道工程。
words.en: The system of pipes, tanks, fittings, and other apparatus required for the water supply, heating, and sanitation in a building.

words.tr:
n. 潜力；
adj. 潜在的；
words.ex: The young athlete shows great potential.
words.ex_cn: 这位年轻运动员展现出巨大的潜力。
words.en: If you say that someone or something has potential, you mean that they have the necessary abilities or qualities to become successful or useful in the future.

words.tr: adj. 务实的；实事求是的；
words.ex: He took a pragmatic approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他采取了务实的方法来解决问题。
words.en: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.ex: Mom reassured me that everything would be fine.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈让我安心，一切都会好起来的。
words.en: If you reassure someone, you comfort them and stop them from worrying.

words.ex: He sits quietly to ruminate on his choices.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐着沉思自己的选择。
words.en: To ruminate means to think deeply about something or to chew the cud, as a cow does.

words.ex: The cartoon is satirical and makes fun of politicians.
words.ex_cn: 这幅漫画是讽刺性的，嘲笑政客。
words.en: A satirical piece of writing or speech uses satire to criticize people or ideas.

words.tr: adj. 中等的；次要的；第二的；
words.ex: He attends a secondary school in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里上一所中学。
words.en: If you describe something as secondary, you mean that it is less important than something else.

words.tr: adj. 不证自明的；不言而喻的
words.ex: It is self-evident that water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 水在100摄氏度沸腾是显而易见的。
words.en: Something that is self-evident is so obvious that there is no need for proof or explanation.

words.ex: His self-indulgent lifestyle led to financial ruin.
words.ex_cn: 他放纵的生活方式导致了财务破产。
words.en: If you say that someone is self-indulgent, you mean that they allow themselves to have or do the things that they enjoy very much, without worrying about whether they are sensible or not.

words.tr: adj. 明智的；有判断力的；恰当的；合理的；
words.ex: It is sensible to wear a coat in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 在寒冷的天气里穿外套是明智的。
words.en: A sensible person is able to make good judgments and decisions based on reason rather than emotion.

words.tr:
n. 纸片；
v. 滑倒；溜走；
words.ex: She found a slip of paper on the table.
words.ex_cn: 她在桌子上发现了一张纸片。
words.en: If you slip, you accidentally slide and lose your balance.

words.ex: He tried to suppress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: To suppress something means to prevent it from being expressed, known, or continuing.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.tr: adj. 第三的；高等教育的
words.ex: He works in the tertiary sector as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名教师在第三产业工作。
words.en: In the context of an economy, the tertiary sector is the part of the economy that provides services rather than producing goods. In geology, the Tertiary period is a former term for the period of time now called the Paleogene and Neogene periods, which followed the Cretaceous period.

words.ex: The transformation of the old factory into a park made the city nicer.
words.ex_cn: 把旧工厂改造成公园让城市变得更美了。
words.en: A transformation is a complete change in the appearance, form, or nature of something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 不让步的；不妥协的；强硬的
words.ex: He is uncompromising about honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他在诚实方面毫不妥协。
words.en: If you describe someone as uncompromising, you mean that they are determined not to change their opinions or aims in any way.

words.tr: adj. 无争议的；公认的；无疑问的
words.ex: His authority is unquestioned by everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的权威被所有人无条件认可。
words.en: If something is unquestioned, it is accepted without any doubt or disagreement.

chapters.name: Unit 2 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: As far as I am concerned, homework is important.
words.ex_cn: 就我而言，作业很重要。
words.en: Used to indicate the perspective or opinion of the speaker regarding a particular subject.

words.tr: phrase. 长久存在；不会消失；将长期持续
words.ex: Online shopping is here to stay, transforming the way we buy everything from groceries to electronics.
words.ex_cn: 网上购物已经成为一种长期存在的趋势，改变了我们购买从食品杂货到电子产品的所有东西的方式。
words.en: If something is here to stay, it has become a permanent part of life and is not likely to disappear or change.

words.tr: phrase. 渐渐消失；平息；变弱
words.ex: The wind will die down in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 风在晚上会逐渐减弱。
words.en: If something dies down, it becomes much less noticeable or active.

words.tr: phrase. 为了某人的缘故；看在某人的份上
words.ex: Do it for your sake.
words.ex_cn: 为了你的缘故，做这件事吧。
words.en: Used to express impatience, annoyance, urgency, or desperation.

words.tr: 为了某事物的缘故；看在某事物的份上
words.ex: He stayed home for her sake.
words.ex_cn: 为了她的缘故，他待在家里。
words.en: For the benefit or purpose of something; for the sake of something.

words.ex: He studied hard for the sake of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习是为了家人。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result.

words.tr: phrase. 在适当的时候；到时候；最终
words.ex: He will get the results in due course.
words.ex_cn: 他会在适当的时候收到结果。
words.en: If you say that something will happen or take place in due course, you mean that it will happen or take place at the appropriate time, not before.

words.ex: The idea is interesting in itself, but it needs further development.
words.ex_cn: 这个想法本身很有趣，但还需要进一步发展。
words.en: considered without other related ideas or situations

words.tr: phrase. 首先；起初；作为第一步
words.ex: In the first instance, let's consider the basic requirements.
words.ex_cn: 首先，让我们考虑基本要求。
words.en: You say in the first instance to mention something that is the first step in a series of actions.

words.tr: phrase. 不妨；还是…为好；倒不如
words.ex: Since you're here, you may as well stay for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 既然你在这儿，不妨留下来吃晚饭。
words.en: used to suggest doing something because there is no good reason not to do it

words.tr: phrase. 还清；得到回报；取得成功
words.ex: He worked hard and finally paid off his debt.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，终于还清了债务。
words.en: If something you have done pays off, it is successful or brings a good result.

words.tr: phrase. 为...辩护； 替...讲好话
words.ex: She speaks up for her friend when others are mean.
words.ex_cn: 当别人对她的朋友不友好时，她为朋友发声。
words.en: To defend or support someone or something publicly.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Text A New Words

words.ex: She responded adaptively to the changing environment.
words.ex_cn: 她适应性地应对变化的环境。
words.en: In a way that is able to adjust to different conditions or environments.

words.ex: He stayed strong through adversity.
words.ex_cn: 他在逆境中保持坚强。
words.en: Adversity refers to a difficult or unlucky situation or event.

words.ex: He started his project anew after the failure.
words.ex_cn: 失败后，他重新开始了他的项目。
words.en: If you do something anew, you do it again, often in a different way from before.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: The enzyme acts as a catalyst in the reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这种酶在反应中充当催化剂。
words.en: A catalyst is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change. In a broader sense, it can also refer to a person or thing that precipitates a change.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.ex: Under these circumstances, we had to cancel the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们不得不取消旅行。
words.en: A circumstance is a fact or event that makes a situation the way it is.

words.tr: n. 开始；毕业典礼；学位授予典礼
words.ex: The commencement of the class was at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 课程的开始时间是上午9点。
words.en: The commencement of something is its beginning.

words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.ex: He didn't study, consequently he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有学习，因此考试不及格。
words.en: As a result; therefore.

words.ex: The colors from red to violet form a continuum.
words.ex_cn: 从红色到紫色的颜色构成一个连续体。
words.en: A continuum is a continuous sequence in which adjacent elements are not perceptibly different from each other, although the extremes are quite distinct.

words.ex: The corporate office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: Corporate relates to large companies or to a particular large company.

words.tr: adj. 产生相反效果的；适得其反的；事与愿违的；
words.ex: Yelling at him is counterproductive.
words.ex_cn: 对他大喊大叫会产生相反的效果。
words.en: Something that is counterproductive achieves the opposite result from the one that you want to achieve.

words.ex: He denies taking the money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认拿了钱。
words.en: To deny means to declare that something is not true, or to refuse to give or grant something.

words.ex: The two colors are distinct.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色有区别。
words.en: If something is distinct, it is easily seen, heard, or understood.

words.ex: The noise will diminish after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后噪音会减少。
words.en: If something diminishes, or if something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.tr: n. 事件；一集；一段经历；
words.ex: The accident was a sad episode in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他生命中的一件悲伤的事。
words.en: An episode is a part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio as one of a series, or a single event or group of related events.

words.ex: He worked hard to fulfill his dream.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的梦想。
words.en: To fulfill a task, role, or function means to do or perform it as required or expected.

words.ex: He feels fulfillment when he helps others.
words.ex_cn: 当他帮助别人时，他感到满足。
words.en: Fulfillment is the feeling of being happy and satisfied because you are doing something useful or important, or because you have achieved something.

words.tr:
v. 发牢骚；抱怨；轰鸣
n. 怨言；牢骚；轰隆声
words.ex: He grumbles when he has to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不早起时就会抱怨。
words.en: If someone grumbles, they complain about something in a bad-tempered way.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.tr: adj. 无效果的；不起作用的；不奏效的；
words.ex: The medicine was ineffective against the cold.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒无效。
words.en: If someone or something is ineffective, they do not achieve the intended result.

words.tr: adj. 根深蒂固的；生染的； v. “ingrain”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: His ingrained habits are hard to change.
words.ex_cn: 他根深蒂固的习惯很难改变。
words.en: If something is ingrained, it is firmly established and therefore difficult to change.

words.tr: adj. 固有的；内在的；本身的；
words.ex: Honesty is an intrinsic part of her character.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是她性格中固有的部分。
words.en: belonging to a thing by its very nature

words.ex: The ship sailed inward toward the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船向港口内航行。
words.en: Directed or moving towards the inside; relating to the inside or inner part of something.

words.tr:
n. 杠杆；杠杆作用；影响力
v. 举债经营；充分利用
words.ex: The mechanic used a lever to lift the car.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用杠杆来抬起汽车。
words.en: Leverage refers to the use of a lever or the mechanical advantage gained by using a lever. In finance, it refers to the use of borrowed capital to increase the potential return of an investment.

words.tr: v. 使增加至最大限度；最大化；
words.ex: He tries to maximize his profit by selling more.
words.ex_cn: 他通过多卖东西来使利润达到最大。
words.en: To maximize something means to make it as great in amount, size, or importance as possible.

words.ex: The caterpillar's metamorphosis into a butterfly takes weeks.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶的变形需要几周时间。
words.en: Metamorphosis is a process of transformation from an immature form to an adult form in two or more distinct stages.

words.ex: He lost his job, which was a great misfortune.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，这是一场巨大的不幸。
words.en: An unfortunate condition or event.

words.ex: His mission is to help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他的使命是帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

words.tr: n. 荒野；[地理]沼泽；系泊（moor 的复数）; v. 使停泊；被系住（moor 的三单形式）
words.ex: The sheep walk on the moors near the village.
words.ex_cn: 羊群在村庄附近的荒原上行走。
words.en: Moors are areas of open, uncultivated land, often covered with heather, that are found in parts of Britain and other countries.

words.tr: v. 导航；应付（复杂情况）；
words.ex: He uses a map to navigate the city.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来导航这座城市。
words.en: To navigate is to plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments or maps.

words.ex: The non-profit helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个非营利组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A non-profit organization is one that is not run with the aim of making a profit.

words.tr: adj. 没注意到的；未觉察的；忘却的；
words.ex: He was oblivious to the noise around him.
words.ex_cn: 他对周围的噪音毫无察觉。
words.en: If you are oblivious to something or oblivious of it, you are not aware of it.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.tr:
v. 投入；跳入
n. 跳进；骤降
words.ex: He plunged into the cold water.
words.ex_cn: 他跳进了冰冷的水里。
words.en: If something or someone plunges in a particular direction, especially into water, they fall, rush, or throw themselves in that direction.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.ex: The parameters are predefine before the experiment begins.
words.ex_cn: 实验开始前，参数已被预先确定。
words.en: To define or determine something in advance.

words.ex: He radically changed his mind about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底改变了对这个计划的想法。
words.en: In a way that is very different from the usual or traditional way.

words.tr: v. 重铸；改写；更换（演员）
words.ex: The director decided to recast the play with a different set of actors.
words.ex_cn: 导演决定用另一组演员重新排演这出戏。
words.en: To recast something means to change it by organizing it in a different way or presenting it in a different form.

words.ex: They reenact the battle every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天都会重演这场战役。
words.en: To enact again; to perform again.

words.ex: The regulatory agency checks food safety.
words.ex_cn: 监管机构检查食品安全。
words.en: Relating to the regulation of something, especially by the government.

words.ex: Exercise can reinforce your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To reinforce something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: He wrote a script for a short movie.
words.ex_cn: 他为一部短片写了剧本。
words.en: A script is the written form of a play, film, or broadcast. It includes the dialogue and stage directions.

words.tr:
v. 向旁侧避让；回避
n. 向侧方跨步
words.ex: He sidestepped the question during the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在采访中回避了这个问题。
words.en: If you sidestep a problem or question, you avoid answering it or dealing with it.

words.tr: adj. 社会的；关于社会的；
words.ex: Social media affects societal behavior.
words.ex_cn: 社交媒体影响社会行为。
words.en: Relating to society or social relations.

words.ex: It is a taboo to speak his name in this village.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村子里，提到他的名字是禁忌。
words.en: A taboo is a social or religious custom prohibiting or restricting a particular practice or forbidding association with a particular person, place, or thing.

words.ex: He wrote his testament before he died.
words.ex_cn: 他在去世前立了遗嘱。
words.en: A testament is a statement of belief or a document that serves as proof or evidence of something.

words.ex: He tragically lost his life in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故中悲惨地失去了生命。
words.en: In a manner that is very sad, often involving death or suffering.

words.tr: adj. 不合意的；不想要的；
words.ex: The weather is undesirable for a picnic.
words.ex_cn: 这种天气不适合野餐。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as undesirable, you think they will have harmful effects or cause problems.

words.tr: adj. 未受启蒙的；不知情的；不文明的；落后的
words.ex: He was unenlightened about the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对新规则一无所知。
words.en: If you describe someone as unenlightened, you mean they have not been given the necessary information or education about something, and so they do not understand it properly.

words.ex: The weather was unfavorable for the picnic.
words.ex_cn: 天气对野餐不利。
words.en: If conditions or circumstances are unfavorable, they make it difficult for something to happen or exist.

words.ex: The diary helped unlock the mystery of her disappearance.
words.ex_cn: 这本日记帮助揭开了她失踪的谜团。
words.en: To unlock something means to open it, or to make it possible for someone to open it, by turning a key or pushing a button.

words.tr: adj. 产量少的；效果不佳的；没有收益的
words.ex: He had an unproductive day at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中度过了毫无成效的一天。
words.en: If someone or something is unproductive, they do not produce very much or do not produce very good results.

words.tr: adj. 不切实际的；不实事求是的；
words.ex: It's unrealistic to expect to get rich quickly.
words.ex_cn: 指望快速致富是不切实际的。
words.en: If you say that someone is being unrealistic, you mean that they do not recognize the truth about a situation, especially about the difficulties involved in something they want to achieve.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 将...付诸行动；把…表演出来
words.ex: He didn't just talk about the plan—he decided to act it out.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅仅谈论这个计划，他还决定将它付诸行动。
words.en: To perform something, such as a play or a story, especially by acting; to express thoughts or feelings through actions.

words.tr: phrase. 正在前往某地；正在向某个目标前进；正处于某种状态或过程之中
words.ex: She is on her way to becoming a successful entrepreneur.
words.ex_cn: 她即将成为一名成功的企业家。
words.en: To be in the process of going to a particular place.

words.tr: phrase. 将各个点连接起来；理解事物之间的关联；看出整体模式
words.ex: He can connect the dots between the two ideas.
words.ex_cn: 他能把这两个想法联系起来。
words.en: To understand or reveal the relationship between different pieces of information.

words.ex: He left early for fear of missing the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早离开，怕赶不上公交车。
words.en: If you do something for fear of something else, you do it to avoid that other thing happening.

words.tr: adj. 没意识到的；不知道的；
words.ex: He was unaware of the rain until he got wet.
words.ex_cn: 他直到被淋湿了才意识到下雨了。
words.en: If you are unaware of something, you do not know about it.

words.tr: phrase. 在使用中的；在服役的；在职的
words.ex: The train is still in service despite its age.
words.ex_cn: 尽管这列火车已经很旧了，但它仍在服务中。
words.en: If a vehicle, machine, or system is in service, it is being used or is available for use.

words.tr: phrase. 正确看待某事；把某事放在合适的角度；保持对某事的客观认识
words.ex: It's important to keep things in perspective and not overreact.
words.ex_cn: 重要的是要正确看待事物，不要反应过度。
words.en: To keep something in perspective means to consider it in relation to everything else, so that you do not have an exaggerated view of its importance.

words.tr: phrase. 发生；展开；使（事件、情节）逐渐发展；使筋疲力尽；使逐渐减弱
words.ex: The game will play out over the next few days.
words.ex_cn: 这场比赛将在接下来的几天内展开。
words.en: To occur or develop in a particular way; to unfold.

words.ex: He seeks out new friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校里主动结交新朋友。
words.en: To seek out means to look for and find someone or something, especially when this is difficult or takes a lot of effort.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人失去平衡；使某人措手不及或慌乱
words.ex: The sudden noise threw him off balance.
words.ex_cn: 突如其来的噪音让他措手不及。
words.en: To cause someone to lose their balance, either physically or emotionally, often by surprising or confusing them.

words.tr: phrase. 为此目的；为了达到那个目标
words.ex: He saved money to that end.
words.ex_cn: 他存钱就是为了那个目的。
words.en: With the aim of achieving that objective.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Text B New Words

words.ex: The architect showed us the blueprint of the new house.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师给我们看了新房子的蓝图。
words.en: A blueprint is a detailed plan or design of something, often used in the context of buildings or machinery, which shows how it is to be made or how it will work.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: He craves chocolate when he is stressed.
words.ex_cn: 当他感到压力时，他渴望吃巧克力。
words.en: If you crave something, or crave for it, you want to have it very much.

words.ex: The cable is disconnected from the computer.
words.ex_cn: 这条线缆从电脑上断开了。
words.en: If something is disconnected, it is not joined to anything else or is not in contact with anything else.

words.ex: He is an expert in the domain of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 他是人工智能领域的专家。
words.en: A domain is a particular field of thought, activity, or interest, especially one over which someone has control, influence, or rights.

words.ex: Running a business entails hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经营企业必然需要努力工作。
words.en: If one thing entails another, it involves it or causes it.

words.ex: He gave an explicit answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了明确的答案。
words.en: Something that is explicit is expressed or shown clearly and openly, without any attempt to hide anything.

words.ex: He is going to marry his fiancée next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月要和未婚妻结婚。
words.en: A woman who is engaged to be married.

words.tr:
adv. 进一步；更远；此外；
adj. 更多的；附加的；
v. 促进；
words.ex: He explained the problem, and then gave further examples.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了这个问题，然后给出了进一步的例子。
words.en: to a greater degree or extent

words.tr:
n. 电话；
v. 打电话；
words.ex: I lost my phone yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天丢了电话。
words.en: A phone is a piece of equipment that you use to talk to someone who is in another place.

words.ex: He spent inordinate time on video games.
words.ex_cn: 他花了过多的时间玩电子游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as inordinate, you are emphasizing that it is unusually or excessively large in amount or degree.

words.ex: The report gives an overview of the project.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告对项目进行了概述。
words.en: An overview is a general summary or review of a subject.

words.tr: v. 使不知所措；使无法解决；击败；压垮；淹没
words.ex: The homework overwhelms her every night.
words.ex_cn: 每天晚上的作业让她感到不堪重负。
words.en: To overwhelm means to bury or drown beneath a huge mass of something, or to defeat someone completely.

words.ex: He writes books under a pseudonym.
words.ex_cn: 他用笔名写书。
words.en: A pseudonym is a name that someone, especially a writer, uses instead of their real name.

words.ex: The instructions were straightforward and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明很简单，容易遵循。
words.en: If you describe something as straightforward, you approve of it because it is easy to do or understand.

words.ex: The succession of rain made the ground wet.
words.ex_cn: 连续的雨水使地面变湿了。
words.en: A succession of things of the same kind is a number of them that exist or happen one after the other.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

words.tr: adv. 有系统地；有组织地；
words.ex: He systematically organized his books by subject.
words.ex_cn: 他有系统地按科目整理了他的书。
words.en: in a thorough, methodical, and organized manner

words.ex: He gave a thoughtful answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个深思的答案。
words.en: If you are thoughtful, you are quiet and serious because you are thinking about something.

words.ex: He still has unfulfilled dreams.
words.ex_cn: 他仍有未实现的梦想。
words.en: If you describe someone's ambitions, hopes, or desires as unfulfilled, you mean that they have not yet achieved the things that they want.

words.ex: He showed great zeal in helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他在帮助他人时表现出极大的热情。
words.en: Zeal is great enthusiasm, especially in connection with work, religion, or politics.

chapters.name: Unit 3 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: The numbers don't add up.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字对不上。
words.en: If facts or events do not add up, they make you confused about a situation because they do not seem to be consistent. If small amounts of something add up, they gradually increase.

words.ex: His actions are consistent with his words.
words.ex_cn: 他的行为与他的言辞一致。
words.en: If one fact or idea is consistent with another, they do not contradict each other.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.ex: He tries to fit in with his new classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力融入新同学中。
words.en: If you fit in with a group of people, you are accepted by them because you are similar to them or because your behaviour is acceptable to them.

words.tr: 短语. 唾手可得的；等待被获取的
words.ex: The championship is for the taking this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的冠军唾手可得。
words.en: If something is for the taking, it is available to be taken or won easily.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 墨守成规；一成不变；陷入枯燥乏味的生活或工作模式
words.ex: After working the same job for ten years, he felt he was in a rut.
words.ex_cn: 在同一个工作岗位上工作了十年后，他感觉自己陷入了困境。
words.en: If someone is in a rut, they are bored and their life or job has become dull because it lacks variety and excitement.

words.tr: phrase. 与…相同；和…一样；与…共有
words.ex: He likes apples, in common with his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，和他妹妹一样。
words.en: If someone or something has something in common with another person or thing, they share the same interests or characteristics.

words.ex: He spoke in support of his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他为朋友说话支持。
words.en: If you do something in support of someone or something, you do it in order to help them or to show that you agree with their aims or actions.

words.tr: phrase. 乍看起来；表面上；从表面上看
words.ex: On the face of it, the plan seems to be a good one.
words.ex_cn: 从表面看，这个计划似乎不错。
words.en: At first glance; apparently.

words.tr: phrase. 与…斗智；与…较量智力
words.ex: He likes to pit his wits against smart people in chess.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在国际象棋中与聪明的人斗智。
words.en: To compete with someone in a test of intelligence or knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 使…与…对抗；使…相互竞争
words.ex: They pit the two teams against each other in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他们在比赛中让两支队伍相互对抗。
words.en: To set someone or something in competition or conflict with someone or something else.

words.ex: He rise to the challenge and help his team win.
words.ex_cn: 他迎接挑战，帮助团队获胜。
words.en: To rise to the challenge means to be ready and able to deal with a difficult situation or task.

words.tr: phrase. 观看；眺望；对…持某种看法
words.ex: Before making a decision, it's important to take a view of all the possible outcomes.
words.ex_cn: 在做决定之前，考虑所有可能的结果是很重要的。
words.en: To consider or assess something carefully before making a decision or forming an opinion.

words.tr: phrase. 采取措施；采取步骤
words.ex: We must take steps to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须采取措施保护环境。
words.en: To take steps means to begin a course of action intended to achieve a particular result.

words.tr: phrase. 利用；接入；汲取（资源、能量、信息等）
words.ex: He taps into his savings to pay for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他动用储蓄来支付旅行费用。
words.en: To make use of a source of energy, knowledge, etc. that already exists.

words.tr: phrase. 权衡；交换；在……之间做出取舍
words.ex: You need to trade off cost against quality when making your decision.
words.ex_cn: 在做决定时，你需要在成本和质量之间进行权衡。
words.en: A trade-off is a situation where you must choose between or balance two things that are opposite or cannot be had at the same time.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text A New Words

words.tr: n. 搅动；煽动；激动；不安
words.ex: The agitation of the water made the dirt rise.
words.ex_cn: 水的搅动使灰尘浮起。
words.en: Agitation is a state of anxiety or nervous excitement.

words.tr: n. （身体或精神的）极度痛苦
words.ex: He felt deep anguish after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 失去狗后，他感到极度痛苦。
words.en: Anguish is extreme mental suffering or physical pain.

words.ex: He is an artistic boy who loves to draw.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢画画的艺术型男孩。
words.en: Someone who is artistic is good at drawing or painting, or arranging things in a beautiful way.

words.tr: n. 收容所；避难所；精神病院；（政治）庇护
words.ex: The old building now serves as an asylum for the homeless.
words.ex_cn: 这栋旧建筑现在是无家可归者的收容所。
words.en: An asylum is a place where people who are in danger or who have no homes can go for safety and protection.

words.ex: This test is a benchmark for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试是所有学生的标准。
words.en: A benchmark is something whose quality or quantity is known and which can therefore be used as a standard with which other things can be compared.

words.tr: n. 一笔；笔的一划；绘画技巧
words.ex: The artist used a bold brushstroke to paint the sky.
words.ex_cn: 画家用大胆的笔触画天空。
words.en: A brushstroke is a single movement of a brush, especially when painting.

words.ex: He paints on a canvas with oil colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用油画颜料在帆布上作画。
words.en: A strong, coarse unbleached cloth made from hemp, flax, cotton, or a similar yarn, used to make items such as sails and tents and as a surface for oil painting.

words.ex: The old cemetery is near the church.
words.ex_cn: 那个古老的墓地在教堂附近。
words.en: A cemetery is a place where dead people are buried.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；外形；等高线
v. 画轮廓（画等高线）
adj. 显示轮廓的
words.ex: The map shows the contour of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山的轮廓。
words.en: The outline of a figure, body, or mass, especially the curved shape of a surface.

words.ex: He conveyed his thanks with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着表达了谢意。
words.en: If you convey information or a message, you communicate it to someone, often in a way that is not direct.

words.ex: The moon looks like a crescent tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚的月亮像一弯新月。
words.en: A crescent is a curved shape that is wider in the middle and pointed at the ends, like the shape of the moon in its first or last quarter.

words.ex: He planted a cypress tree near the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园旁种了一棵柏树。
words.en: A cypress is a type of tree that is known for its dark green foliage and its ability to grow in a variety of climates. It is often associated with mourning and is commonly found in cemeteries.

words.tr: adj. 装饰性的；作装饰用的；
words.ex: The room has decorative flowers on the table.
words.ex_cn: 房间里桌上有一些装饰性的花。
words.en: Something that is decorative is intended to look pretty or attractive.

words.ex: The painting depicts a quiet village at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一个宁静的村庄在日落时分的景象。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.tr:
n. 漠视；忽视；
v. 漠视；不理会；不顾；
words.ex: His advice was met with disregard.
words.ex_cn: 他的建议遭到了漠视。
words.en: If you disregard something, you ignore it or do not take account of it.

words.ex: He works hard to emulate his older brother.
words.ex_cn: 他努力赶上他的哥哥。
words.en: To emulate someone or something means to try to be like them or to do something in the same way that they do it.

words.ex: Love is for eternity.
words.ex_cn: 爱是永恒的。
words.en: Eternity refers to infinite or unending time, or a state to which time has no application; timelessness.

words.ex: The magic show had a strange fascination for children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演对孩子们有一种奇特的迷惑力。
words.en: A fascination is a very strong interest or attraction for someone or something.

words.ex: The fluidity of the liquid made it easy to pour.
words.ex_cn: 液体的流动性使其易于倾倒。
words.en: The quality of being able to change or be changed easily.

words.tr: adj. 黑暗的；幽暗的；忧郁的；沮丧的
words.ex: The room was gloomy with no windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间没有窗户，很黑暗。
words.en: If a place is gloomy, it is almost dark so that you cannot see very well. If people are gloomy, they are unhappy and have no hope.

words.tr:
n. 冰雹；
v. 把…誉为；
words.ex: The hail broke many car windows.
words.ex_cn: 冰雹打碎了许多汽车窗户。
words.en: Hail is small balls of ice that fall like rain from the sky. It can also mean to call out to someone in order to attract their attention, or to praise someone enthusiastically.

words.tr: v. 使不朽；使永存；使名垂千古
words.ex: The statue will immortalize the hero.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像将使这位英雄永垂不朽。
words.en: To immortalize someone or something means to make them famous for a very long time, often by creating a work of art or literature about them.

words.ex: The luminous moon lights up the night.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的月亮照亮了夜晚。
words.en: Something that is luminous shines or glows in the dark.

words.tr:
n. 哀悼；悲痛；服丧
v. 悼念；哀痛；“mourn”的现在分词
words.ex: He is mourning the loss of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为失去他的狗而哀悼。
words.en: Mourning is the expression of deep sorrow for someone who has died, typically involving following certain conventions such as wearing black clothes.

words.ex: Owls are nocturnal animals.
words.ex_cn: 猫头鹰是夜间活动的动物。
words.en: Nocturnal means happening in the night or active at night.

words.ex: He opted to stay home instead of going out.
words.ex_cn: 他选择待在家里而不是出去。
words.en: If you opt for something, or opt to do something, you choose it or decide to do it in preference to anything else.

words.ex: The painter arranged his colors on the palette.
words.ex_cn: 画家把颜色放在调色板上。
words.en: A palette is a flat piece of wood, plastic, etc., on which an artist mixes paints.

words.ex: The reception at the hotel was very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的接待非常友好。
words.en: The act of receiving or being received, especially in a formal or official context.

words.tr: v. 反映；反射；反省；思考；仔细考虑；
words.ex: The mirror reflects the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 镜子反射阳光。
words.en: If a surface reflects light, heat, sound, or an image, it sends the light, etc. back and does not absorb it. If something is reflected in a mirror or in water, you can see its image in the mirror or in the water.

words.tr: n. 心神不定； 坐立不安；烦躁
words.ex: The child's restlessness during the long car ride was difficult to manage.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在漫长的车程中坐立不安，很难管理。
words.en: A feeling of agitation or anxiety caused by the inability to remain still or at rest.

words.ex: The resurrection of the dead is a key belief in Christianity.
words.ex_cn: 死者的复活是基督教的核心信仰。
words.en: The act of rising from the dead or returning to life; the revival of something that had been dormant or inactive.

words.ex: He tried to retract his words after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争吵后试图收回他的话。
words.en: If you retract something that you have said or written, you say that you did not mean it.

words.tr:
n. 螺旋形；陡升或骤降；
v. 螺旋式上升（或下降）；
adj. 螺旋形的；
words.ex: The snail moved along a spiral path.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛沿着一个螺旋形的路径爬行。
words.en: A spiral is a shape which winds round and round, with each curve above or outside the previous one.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.tr:
v. 旋动；（使）成漩涡；盘旋
n. 漩涡；涡状形
words.ex: The milk swirls in the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 牛奶在咖啡里旋转。
words.en: If something swirls or if you swirl it, it moves around and around quickly.

words.ex: The texture of the bread is soft and fluffy.
words.ex_cn: 这种面包的质地柔软蓬松。
words.en: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or a substance.

words.ex: The tree grows in a vertical line.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树垂直生长。
words.en: Something that is vertical stands or points straight up.

words.tr:
v. （使）回旋；（使）旋转
n. 一连串的事；混乱；尝试
words.ex: The wind makes the leaves whirl around.
words.ex_cn: 风让树叶旋转飞舞。
words.en: To move or cause to move rapidly around and around.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.tr: phrase. 在……的顶峰；在……最兴盛或最强烈的时候
words.ex: At the height of his career, he was known worldwide.
words.ex_cn: 在他的职业生涯的顶峰时期，他在全世界都很有名。
words.en: At the most intense or extreme point of something.

words.tr: phrase. 充满，洋溢（指某物装得满满的，常用于抽象事物如情感、活力等）
words.ex: The room brimmed with joy during the celebration.
words.ex_cn: 庆祝活动期间，房间里洋溢着喜悦。
words.en: If someone or something is brimming with a particular quality, feeling, or thing, they are full of it.

words.ex: The smell of cookies brings to mind my childhood.
words.ex_cn: 饼干的香味让我想起了我的童年。
words.en: To cause someone to remember or think of something.

words.tr: phrase. 用魔法召唤；（魔法般）变出；使浮现脑海
words.ex: The witch tried to conjure up a dragon.
words.ex_cn: 女巫试图用魔法召唤一条龙。
words.en: To make something appear or come to mind, especially as if by magic.

words.tr: phrase. 与……形成对比；与……对照
words.ex: Her dress contrasts with the white walls.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子与白墙形成对比。
words.en: To show differences when compared.

words.tr: phrase. 引起对……的注意；使关注
words.ex: He raises his hand to draw attention to his question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起手来引起对他的问题的注意。
words.en: To make someone notice or be aware of something.

words.ex: Good teachers are in great demand.
words.ex_cn: 好老师非常紧缺。
words.en: If something is in great demand, it is wanted or needed by a lot of people.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

chapters.name: Unit 4 Text B New Words

words.tr: adv. 气压上；大气所致地；气压所致地
words.ex: The concert was enhanced atmospherically by the fog machine.
words.ex_cn: 雾气机增强了音乐会的氛围。
words.en: In a way that relates to the atmosphere or creates a particular mood or atmosphere.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.tr:
n. 圣歌；赞美诗；喊叫
v. 吟唱；诵扬；反复叫喊
words.ex: The monks sang a traditional chant during the morning prayer.
words.ex_cn: 修道士们在晨祷时唱了一首传统圣歌。
words.en: A chant is a word or group of words that is repeated over and over again. It can also refer to a simple song, especially one that is sung in a religious service.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: A car has many components, like wheels and engines.
words.ex_cn: 汽车有许多部分，比如轮子和发动机。
words.en: A component is a part of a larger whole, especially a part that can be separated from or attached to a system.

words.ex: The rain and the thunder happened in conjunction.
words.ex_cn: 雨和雷声同时发生。
words.en: A conjunction is a word that is used to connect clauses or sentences or to coordinate words in the same clause.

words.ex: The church has a big dome above the altar.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的祭坛上方有一个大穹顶。
words.en: A dome is a rounded vault made of either curved segments or a shell of revolution, meaning an arch rotated around its central vertical axis.

words.ex: The boat is made of fiberglass.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船是用玻璃纤维制成的。
words.en: A material consisting of extremely fine filaments of glass that are combined in yarn and woven into fabrics, used in textiles and for insulation and reinforcement of plastics.

words.ex: The book has a finite number of pages.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的页数是有限的。
words.en: Something that is finite has a definite fixed size or extent.

words.ex: The glow of the fire warmed the room.
words.ex_cn: 火的炽热温暖了房间。
words.en: If something glows, it produces a dull, steady light.

words.tr:
v. 保证；确保；
n. 保证；保证书；
words.ex: The store guarantees a refund if you are not happy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不满意，商店保证退款。
words.en: A guarantee is a formal promise that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if it is not of a specified quality.

words.ex: The garden was filled with the sweet scent of heliotrope.
words.ex_cn: 花园里弥漫着天芥菜属植物的甜香。
