words.ex: The composer's latest work is a symphonic masterpiece.
words.ex_cn: 这位作曲家的最新作品是一部交响乐杰作。
words.en: Relating to or having the form or character of a symphony.

words.ex: The trader sells fruits every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人每天早上卖水果。
words.en: A trader is a person who buys and sells goods, currencies, or shares.

words.ex: Her talent trumped his experience.
words.ex_cn: 她的才华胜过了他的经验。
words.en: In card games, a trump is a card of a suit which has been chosen to rank above the other suits. As a verb, to trump means to beat someone or something by doing or producing something better.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text A Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He is ahead of his classmates in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学上比同学领先。
words.en: In front of or before something in time or space.

words.tr: phrase. 处境危险；遭受危险
words.ex: The children are at risk without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子如果没有适当的照顾就会有危险。
words.en: In a situation where there is a possibility of something bad happening.

words.ex: He still clings to his old beliefs.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然坚持自己的旧信念。
words.en: To hold on tightly to something or someone, either physically or emotionally, often because of fear, love, or a strong desire.

words.ex: He excels in math.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面很出色。
words.en: If someone excels in something, they are very good at doing it.

words.ex: The lamp gives off a warm light.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯发出温暖的光。
words.en: If something gives off or gives out a gas, heat, or a smell, it produces it and sends it out into the air.

words.ex: If you don't work hard, you might lose out to others.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不努力，你可能会输给别人。
words.en: To be defeated by or fail to compete successfully against someone or something.

words.ex: I can't put up with his loud noise every night.
words.ex_cn: 我无法忍受他每晚的噪音。
words.en: To tolerate or endure something unpleasant or annoying.

words.ex: He resides in a small village near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他住在山附近的一个小村庄里。
words.en: If someone or something resides in a particular place, they are in that place; if a quality resides in something, it is present in that thing.

words.tr: phrase. 擦掉；磨掉；（品质、习惯等）逐渐影响他人，感染；使沾上
words.ex: His good mood rubbed off on everyone around him.
words.ex_cn: 他的好心情感染了周围的所有人。
words.en: If a quality or characteristic that someone has rubs off, it starts to affect other people, especially because they spend a lot of time together.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text B New Words

words.ex: He abetted his friend to steal the car.
words.ex_cn: 他教唆朋友偷车。
words.en: To abet someone to do something wrong means to help or encourage them to do it.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.ex: Her courage in facing danger is admirable.
words.ex_cn: 她在面对危险时表现出的勇气令人钦佩。
words.en: If you say that something is admirable, you mean that you approve of it or respect it.

words.tr: adv. 显然；表面上看起来；
words.ex: He is apparently late for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他显然迟到了会议。
words.en: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard, but you are not certain that it is true.

words.tr: v. 断言；宣称；坚持；维护
words.ex: He asserts that the answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持认为答案是正确的。
words.en: To state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.

words.ex: He drove at a breakneck speed down the mountain road.
words.ex_cn: 他以惊险的速度沿着山路开车。
words.en: If you say that something happens or travels at breakneck speed, you mean that it happens or travels very fast.

words.tr:
n. 半身像；胸部；搜捕
v. 打碎；搜捕
adj. 破产的；打碎的
words.ex: The museum has a marble bust of the ancient king.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一座古代国王的大理石半身像。
words.en: A bust is a sculpture of a person's head, shoulders, and chest. As a verb, to bust means to break something, to arrest someone, or to go bankrupt.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.ex: He went to the casino to play poker.
words.ex_cn: 他去赌场玩扑克。
words.en: A casino is a building where people can gamble by playing games of chance or betting on events.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；堵塞的； v. “congest” 的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The road was congested with cars during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段，这条路被汽车挤满了。
words.en: If a place is congested, it is extremely crowded and blocked with traffic or people.

words.ex: He tried to curb his horse with the reins.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用缰绳勒住马。
words.en: If you curb something, you control it and keep it within limits.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.tr:
v. 疏浚；挖掘
n. 挖泥船；疏浚机
words.ex: They dredge the river to remove mud.
words.ex_cn: 他们疏浚河流以清除淤泥。
words.en: To dredge means to remove mud, sand, or other material from the bottom of a river, lake, etc., in order to make it deeper or to search for something.

words.ex: The drought made it hard to grow crops.
words.ex_cn: 旱灾使种植庄稼变得困难。
words.en: A drought is a long period of time during which no rain falls and hence there is a shortage of water.

words.tr: adj. 新纪元的；划时代的
words.ex: The invention of the internet was an epochal event.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明是一个划时代的事件。
words.en: An epochal event or change is one that is very important and has a great effect on future events.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.tr: n. 爆炸；（感情）爆发；激增；
words.ex: The explosion broke all the windows.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸震碎了所有的窗户。
words.en: An explosion is a sudden, violent burst of energy, for example one caused by a bomb.

words.ex: The floor was filthy after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨过后，地板变得非常肮脏。
words.en: Something that is filthy is extremely dirty.

words.tr: n. 丧失抵押品赎回权
words.ex: The bank initiated foreclosure proceedings after the borrower defaulted on the mortgage.
words.ex_cn: 借款人在抵押贷款违约后，银行启动了丧失抵押品赎回权的程序。
words.en: The legal process by which a lender takes control of a property, evicts the homeowner and sells the home after a homeowner is unable to make full principal and interest payments on his or her mortgage, as stipulated in the mortgage contract.

words.ex: The glitzy party had bright lights and fancy dresses.
words.ex_cn: 这场华丽的派对有明亮的灯光和精致的礼服。
words.en: Something that is glitzy is showily attractive or impressive, often in a way that is considered tasteless.

words.ex: A megacity has more than ten million people.
words.ex_cn: 一个大城市有超过一千万人。
words.en: A megacity is a very large city, typically one with a population of over ten million people.

words.tr: adj. 超大型的；特大号的
words.ex: He bought a mega-size pizza for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对买了一个超大比萨。
words.en: Mega-size refers to something that is extremely large or on a very large scale.

words.ex: He takes the metro to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A metro is an underground railway system in a city.

words.ex: He lives in a big metropolis with many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个有很多高楼的大都市里。
words.en: A metropolis is a very large city, often the most important city in a country or area.

words.ex: He felt nothingness after the loss.
words.ex_cn: 失去后，他感到一片虚无。
words.en: The state of being nothing; nonexistence.

words.ex: The travelers found an oasis with water and trees.
words.ex_cn: 旅行者们发现了一个有水和树木的绿洲。
words.en: An oasis is a small area in a desert where water and plants are found, making it a place of relief and beauty in an otherwise barren landscape.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.ex: Overpopulation causes more traffic and pollution.
words.ex_cn: 人口过剩导致更多的交通和污染。
words.en: Overpopulation refers to a situation where the number of people in an area exceeds the capacity of the environment to support life at a decent standard of living.

words.ex: His talent overshadowed his brother's achievements.
words.ex_cn: 他的才华使他兄弟的成就黯然失色。
words.en: If an unpleasant event or feeling overshadows something, it makes it less happy or enjoyable.

words.ex: She wore a white pearl necklace.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一条白色的珍珠项链。
words.en: A pearl is a hard, rounded object formed within the shell of a pearl oyster or similar mollusk, highly prized as a gemstone.

words.tr: n. 诉讼；（会议）记录；“proceeding”的复数；
words.ex: The proceedings took longer than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这场诉讼比预期的时间更长。
words.en: The proceedings are the series of events or actions that happen in a particular situation, especially in a legal case or a meeting.

words.ex: They decided to prolong the meeting by one hour.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定将会议延长一小时。
words.en: To prolong something means to make it last longer.

words.ex: The two countries signed a protocol to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项停止战争的协议。
words.en: A protocol is a set of rules or a system of rules about the correct way to act in formal situations.

words.ex: Many people lost jobs during the recession.
words.ex_cn: 在经济不景气期间，许多人失去了工作。
words.en: A recession is a period when the economy of a country is not doing well, industrial production and business activity are at a low level, and many people are unemployed.

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天给你打电话。
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: The seafloor is home to a variety of marine life.
words.ex_cn: 海底是各种海洋生物的家园。
words.en: The bottom of a sea or ocean.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.ex: He felt guilt for his sin of lying.
words.ex_cn: 他因撒谎的罪行感到内疚。
words.en: Sin is an action or behaviour that is considered to be morally wrong according to religious or social laws.

words.ex: Many families live in the slum near the city center.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在城市中心附近的贫民窟里。
words.en: A slum is a heavily populated urban area characterized by substandard housing and squalor.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.tr:
adj. 肿胀的；上涨的
v. 膨胀；肿胀；“swell”的过去分词
words.ex: His ankle is swollen after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒后脚踝肿了。
words.en: If a part of your body is swollen, it is larger and rounder than normal, usually as a result of injury or illness.

words.ex: The country expanded its territory after the war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在战争后扩大了它的领土。
words.en: An area of land that is controlled by a particular country, ruler, or military force.

words.ex: The theme of the essay is friendship.
words.ex_cn: 这篇作文的题目是友谊。
words.en: The subject or main idea in a talk, piece of writing, or work of art.

words.ex: The factory uses unsustainable methods to save money.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂为了省钱而使用不可持续的方法。
words.en: If something is unsustainable, it cannot continue at the same rate or in the same way.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text B Phrases and Expressions

words.ex: He came to class as late as 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他直到早上9点才来上课。
words.en: used to indicate that something happens or exists until a particular time

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.tr: phrase. 满足于； 对 ... 感到满足
words.ex: He is content with his small house.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的小房子感到满足。
words.en: To be satisfied with what one has or is, without desiring more or something else.

words.tr: phrase. 使充气；爆炸；发怒；夸大
words.ex: He blew up the balloon with his mouth.
words.ex_cn: 他用嘴把气球吹鼓了。
words.en: If someone blows something up or if it blows up, it is destroyed by an explosion.

words.ex: The river may dry up in the summer.
words.ex_cn: 这条河在夏天可能会干涸。
words.en: If something dries up or if something dries it up, it loses all its moisture and becomes completely dry.

words.tr: phrase. 取得巨大成功；成名；进入重要阶段
words.ex: He hit the big time after his song went viral.
words.ex_cn: 他的歌走红后，他一举成名。
words.en: To achieve great success or fame, especially in the entertainment industry.

words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.tr: phrase. 呕吐；恶心；匆匆建造；产生；放弃
words.ex: He eats too fast and sometimes throws up.
words.ex_cn: 他吃得很快，有时会呕吐。
words.en: To vomit; to eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth.

words.tr: phrase. 使停止往前；往回走
words.ex: He turned back when he saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到狗时，他往回走了。
words.en: To go back in the direction you have come from, or to make someone or something do this.
